siteFooter.$description: Stroke width of the line above the site footer (BR-13).

bg.$description: Fill of the site footer: the pure black page (BR-03). The footer is separated from the page by its line, not by a surface color (C-05).

line.$description: Color of the line above the site footer: brand pink, like the header line (BR-01, ADR-0030). Chosen by the owner in ADR-0030.
